Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sandro Marcos leaves father’s party, joins Lakas

blocks.text: House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos leaves Partido Federal, his father President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.’s party, and joins Lakas CMD.

items: DSWD demos water filtration kits to push Marcos’ bucket wisdom

blocks.text: The Department of Social Welfare and Development may distribute water filtration kits to communities vulnerable to El Niño and possible water shortages.

items: JV Ejercito flags ‘major changes’ in House-approved 2027 budget bill

blocks.text: Senate finance committee chairperson JV Ejercito flags significant cuts to preventive health programs and infrastructure projects in the P7.2-trillion 2027 general appropriations bill.

items: Rapper-economist Cielo Magno confirms she will run for Senate

blocks.text: Economist Cielo Magno announces she will run for senator in the 2028 elections.

items: Pope Leo back on his feet after shock cancer diagnosis

blocks.text: Pope Leo is back on his feet, walking in his hospital room, and eating normally. – Rappler.com
